visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a navy blue sweatshirt sits prominently on the left side of a gray couch, holding a black microphone. He looks towards his right with a focused, singing expression. A woman with long dark hair sits next to him, engrossed in her black smartphone. A small Yorkshire Terrier rests quietly on her lap in a brightly lit modern living room. (2) The man begins to sing more intensely, gesturing with his left hand to emphasize his words. His eyebrows furrow and his mouth opens wide. The woman looks up from her screen, her expression shifting from distraction to mild annoyance as she continues to hold her phone, occasionally tapping it. (3) The man turns his body towards the woman, his gestures becoming more dramatic and pleading. He touches his chest with one hand. The woman now looks directly at him, appearing confused and slightly overwhelmed by his theatrical performance, yet she remains seated with the dog. (4) The camera remains static as the man stands up from the sofa, still holding the microphone and singing. He walks towards the right of the frame, exiting the living room area. The woman is left sitting on the couch, watching him leave with a wide-eyed, stunned expression.
